name: Shapers
tagline: Find engineers and scientists through their public work.
description: Search by role or project, explore similar repositories, and inspect profiles with linked evidence from code, papers, and other public work.

env.name: SHAPERS_API_KEY
env.description: Your Shapers workspace API key for key-based access.

install.notes: For key-based access, configure the X-API-Key header on the Shapers connection with your workspace API key. See https://shapers.si/docs/mcp for tool inputs and credit costs.
